briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: A comprehensive investigation into alleged social welfare fraud in Minnesota has resulted in the raids of 22 businesses, many of which are Somali-linked. The investigation has also led to the indictment of former FBI Director James Comey on charges of threatening the President. The raids and indictment suggest a larger pattern of corruption and abuse of power. Further investigation is needed to uncover the full extent of these crimes and to identify key individuals and organizations involved. The Minnesota State Government and federal agencies must work together to combat this corruption and ensure that those responsible are held accountable.
